name: 32934 · Melbourne, FL
findings: ZIP 32934 (Melbourne) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32934 (Melbourne) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32934 (Melbourne) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
